content: Diabetes Health magazine, published by King's Publishing in California, United States, is one of the largest publications in the U.S. dedicated to diabetes. It focuses on the challenges and complications faced daily by individuals living with diabetes, as well as their families and friends. In 1989, the company began as a mail-order diabetes supply business. However, they soon recognized that their customers needed more than just supplies—they needed reliable information as well. This realization led to the creation of a radio show called “Diabetes on the Dial,” which featured interviews with world-class experts in the field of diabetes. The popularity of the radio show and the demand for transcripts of its broadcasts eventually inspired the company to launch a monthly magazine. Initially named Diabetes Interview, the publication was later renamed Diabetes Health. For 14 consecutive years, Diabetes Health magazine has been providing in-depth articles and resources to help individuals manage and live with diabetes effectively.
